description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a reusable message template (never sent on its own; tagged `mcp`). Example content: {"headings":{"en":"Your cart is waiting"},"contents":{"en":"{{ first_name | default: \"Hi\" }}, your items are still in your cart."}}.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

channel.description: Template channel (empty means multi-channel): ios_push, android_push, web_push, email, sms…

name: create_template_draft
title: Create template draft
